answer.reason: From recall rather than a database search, the sequence matches human ADP-ribosylarginine hydrolase ARH1 (parent enzyme EC 3.2.2.19), but the conserved S-D-D motif reads S-A-D, so the essential Asp55 is replaced by Ala. Mutagenesis of either vicinal aspartate in ARH1 is reported to severely reduce or abolish hydrolase activity, so this variant is predicted inactive, though trace residual activity cannot be excluded.
